correctness.rationale: For n≥7 a 6-coloring forces alternating rung colors from a six-edge conflict clique; the four remaining horizontal colors force the swap c(t_{i+2})=c(b_i), c(b_{i+2})=c(t_i), hence nondegenerate period four and 4|n. The n=3,5,6 exceptions follow exhaustive small induced-matching counts (histograms 1,9; 1,15,25; 1,18,57,2). The four-column 6-color pattern and finite 7-/8-color seeds were read from construct.py and checked by a separately implemented every-conflicting-edge-pair verifier for n=3..150. The four-column insertion proof uses repeated matching seam columns and proves all n, not finite extrapolation. Thus index equals 9 at 3, 8 at 5,6, 6 when 4|n, and 7 otherwise.
